name: Drinking Blood
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that the life of flesh is in the blood, which God has set apart for atonement and not for consumption. While God permitted eating all living creatures, He strictly forbade consuming blood, emphasizing its sacred role in making atonement for the soul. Violating this command brought severe judgment, as seen in the Mosaic law. In the New Testament, Jesus deepens this truth by calling believers to spiritually partake of His flesh and blood for eternal life, highlighting the profound significance of blood in the covenant of salvation.
